name: Nightmare x Sisters ~Ingoku no Sacrifice~
original_name: Nightmare×Sisters～淫獄のサクリファイス～
source:
The protagonist, Shindou Setsuna, is a female student attending school. She spends time after classes and free days doing holy sister activities with her sister Yuuka. Yet these girls are not just ordinary holy sisters; they have another side. This side is the exorcist one—they cleanse demons that possess people under the cover of night.

Lately, demons have been appearing more often, so the protagonist thought that it was a bad omen. And just then, her sister, Yuuka, was taken prisoner by someone and vanished without a trace. Setsuna searches for her traces with her childhood friend Kitakawa Touma and the holy father, to whom she is so indebted.

Furthermore, the one who kidnapped Yuuka went even for Setsuna. And this was an introduction to the endless hell of debauchery...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013237.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
主人公神堂刹那平日里是一名在校女生。放学后和休息日，她与姐姐悠果一起从事修女的工作。然而，她们并非普通的修女，还拥有另一重身份：驱魔师，负责驱逐那些隐匿于黑夜、附身于人的恶魔。

最近，恶魔出现得越来越频繁，刹那隐隐觉得这可能是某种不祥之兆。就在这时，姐姐悠果被不明人士掳走，失去了踪迹。刹那与青梅竹马喜多川冬马，以及一直照顾她们的神父一起寻找悠果的下落。

然而，绑走悠果的人又将魔爪伸向了刹那。而这一切，只是无尽性暴力苦难的开端……

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013237.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLsite[/url]]
